public_nonduplicate_tasks.evidence: 1,500 released VQA questions with distinct image-geometry tuples; 899 released source images.

relevant_foundation_model.evidence: Intern-S1 is a named multimodal scientific foundation model with reported materials relevance; benchmark-specific MATCHA benefit is not established.

harbor.evidence: All 100 frozen tasks were scheduled through Harbor with real images; pilot transport recordings matched staged images byte-for-byte.

deepseek_binary_accuracy.evidence: 70/100 full-credit binary successes over all scheduled attempts; no missing rewards. Precommitted 98.333% Wilson and paper-cluster intervals cross the strict 70% ceiling. A prematurely stopped expansion retains every completed attempt and will resume without rerunning them if corroboration does not establish verifier failure.

verifier_false_positive.evidence: GPT-5.1 flagged 28/100 sampled tasks, but single-judge disagreement is not scientific ground truth. Every flag is frozen for a second blind provider; disagreements and abstentions count as non-errors in denominator 100.

verifier_false_negative.evidence: GPT-5.1 flagged 28/100 sampled tasks, but each specific alternate must be independently corroborated blind before counting. Wilson and paper-group cluster uncertainty are required because this is a sample of 1,500, not a census.

audit_independence: Primary flags are not a verdict. Claude Sonnet 4.6 will receive figures, questions and options while blind to gold, GPT outcomes and verifier outcomes.
